title: Search: Add Site Search to Your Site | Orchard Core
description:
Visitors expect to find a page by typing a few words, but a site has no search until it has an index to look words up in and a page to search from.

Orchard Core builds site search from a search provider such as Lucene, an index of your content, the Search feature, and a permission that lets visitors query the index. This video sets all of them up on a Blog site, adds a search box with the Search Form widget, and tries the result as a visitor who is not signed in.

In this video:
• How site search works: indexes, providers and the search page
• Enabling the Lucene and Search features
• Creating an index of Blog Post and Article content
• Choosing the default index in the Site Search settings
• Letting visitors query the index with the Anonymous role
• Adding a search box with the Search Form widget
• Searching as a visitor
• Keeping an index in step with Synchronize, Reset and Rebuild
